text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho, the final leg 
of the Classic Triple Crown. Under the 
refreshing blue sky, Seiun Sky remained at 
her usual, easygoing pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, her fellow rivals among the Big 
Three, Special Week and King Halo, both 
seemed fully fired up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the setup was complete. Seiun Sky 
headed toward the race, fully intending to 
outwit everyone.
